listing.name: Configuration Tool Showcase
listing.summary: Starsector has a large and active community, yet it has long lacked efficient and user-friendly tools for developers. So, we decided to build one.
listing.aiSummary: Lets developers preview and configure non-code and non-art content, including ships, factions, and projectiles, through a unified editor.

description:
Configuration Tool Showcase v1.7-beta
[Developer MOD Configuration Tool] Ship Editor
Starsector has a large and active community, yet it has long lacked efficient and user-friendly tools for developers. So, we decided to build one.

Developers: Cake, AnyIDElse

The tool supports hot loading and hot updates, making planning and configuration work more convenient and efficient.

Development Goals
Our goal is to allow all non-code and non-art content to be previewed and configured through this tool. It also supports configuration editing across multiple CSV files.

Changelog
2026/05/12
Updated the Projectile Editor; fixed issues and refactored the project, including frontend-backend separation.

2026/05/12 – 2026/05/15
Standardized the Editor IDE; updated the UI; improved both frontend and backend; consolidated bug fixes.
The current version is now ready to use after extraction.

2026/05/16
Major improvements to the Faction Editor for a better editing experience.

2026/05/16 – 2026/05/19
Fixed a large number of issues and rebuilt the UI, among other improvements.
Special thanks to AnyIDElse!

2026/05/19 – 2026/05/30
Upgraded the UI and user experience; fixed a huge number of issues; rewrote the loading architecture; updated CSV editing features; localized entry tags and other content; and added static checks.
This update also includes extensive performance improvements and interaction logic updates.
Special thanks to AnyIDElse!

2026/05/30 – 2026/07/04
Routine updates and optimizations; overall architecture reorganization; improved read/write performance; enhanced ship and ship-system editors; continued debugging and issue fixes.

2026/08/03
Significant performance improvements and bug fixes. The editor may briefly lag when opened for the first time because it needs to build indexes and caches. Once indexing and caching are complete, the editor becomes much smoother and should no longer experience stuttering during normal use.

2026/08/06
Improved the UI for better usability and fixed related issues.
